name: zclass_camera_update_impl
description: zClass_Camera::UpdateImpl refreshes camera world transform, projection/frustum plane state, frustum corner vectors, and near/far clip centers.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this camera update helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44aa30 validates BuildWorldTransform dispatch, transformDirty staging, conditional projection-state rebuild when local frustum normals are dirty, zClipAlt_BuildFrustumPlanes dispatch, conditional frustum vector/corner rebuild, near/far clip center updates from cameraPos plus forwardDir scaled by clip distances, and zero return.

The native camera smoke verifies projection dirty-bit clearing, transformDirty clear, frustum vector dirty-bit clearing, far-plane corner z values, and near/far clip center updates after an offset camera update.
